plan.title: Configural lesions in deep networks: analysis plan

data.weighting: category-balanced; categories with fewer than 20 hold-out objects excluded from primary means

measures.floor_rule: CR not computed if lower 95% bound of A_grid < 0.125; reported as floor, counts as not supporting
measures.score_probability: mean probability of the true category (16-way)

units.unit: channel at a site, ablated across all spatial positions
units.primary_score: I_conf(c) = [P_grid - P_grid(-c)] - [P_scr - P_scr(-c)], single-channel zero ablation
units.reliability: split-half Spearman, Spearman-Brown corrected, >= 0.7 for a site to be lesioned
units.configural_set: channels with I_conf reliably > 0: one-sided test across localizer objects, Benjamini-Hochberg q = 0.05; bounded to 1-40% of site channels (top 1% or 40% if outside); no fixed fraction (Dobs et al. 20% has no stated rationale)
units.local_set: from channels with I_conf <= site median, top channels by local score; size chosen so damage is closest to the configural set's
units.selective_set: paired t-test grid > scrambled on spatially averaged response, Benjamini-Hochberg q = 0.05 (secondary)
units.primary_site: reliable site with the largest summed I_conf over its configural set (localizer half)

lesions.robustness_method: mean ablation (channel mean over calibration images); robust only if both agree
lesions.damage: drop in grid-control accuracy on the calibration localizer half

other_sites.set_rule: same FDR rule as primary site

probes.type: linear, L2 logistic regression on penultimate features
probes.cv: 5-fold, grouped by object, on calibration features
probes.control_task: labels shuffled at object level; selectivity = task - control accuracy

hypotheses.H2: dCR(config) - mean dCR(random), size- and damage-matched: both upper bounds < 0; and dCR(config) below 5th percentile of the 100 damage-matched random lesions
hypotheses.H4: hue and scrambled-category probe drops, config minus damage-matched random: upper bound < 0.05
hypotheses.H5: JS distance to BagNet-33 errors falls more than after damage-matched random lesions
hypotheses.H6: edge minus silhouette accuracy falls more than after damage-matched random lesions
hypotheses.H7: multi-label overlap cost rises more than after damage-matched random lesions

statistics.bootstrap: category-stratified cluster bootstrap over objects, 10000 resamples, percentile intervals, conditions resampled jointly
statistics.multiplicity: Holm within family: primary H1-H3 x 2 models (6 tests); secondary H4-H7 x 2 models (8 tests); family-wise 0.05
statistics.scope: primary model decides headline; 'general' only if both models support
